children: American Healthcare REIT appointed Aric Chang as Chief Financial Officer, effective October 1, 2026, following Brian S. Peay's retirement as CFO effective September 30, 2026.
Retirement; not due to any disagreement with the company
Replaces Brian S. Peay as CFO

Age 47; CFO, Real Estate at Public Storage since May 2023; senior finance roles at Rexford Industrial Realty, Rouse Properties; Exec Dir Research & Strategy at J.P. Morgan Asset Management; B.S. Wharton, MBA Columbia
Will serve as non-employee consultant through April 15, 2027; outstanding equity awards continue to vest
